items.description: Acknowledges Laozi's corrective while maintaining position, then shifts burden by asking for practical alternative
items.trigger: When Laozi critiques rites or structure as artificial or corrupting

example.quote: You have named a tension I recognize... But what is your alternative?

items.description: Extracts shared practical principle from different emphases to find common ground with Buddha
items.trigger: When discussion reaches apparent impasse between cultivation-of-self and no-self

example.quote: Both agree: knowledge that doesn't shape action is incomplete

items.description: Forces abstract discussion to concrete by invoking real human situations that demand practical response
items.trigger: When dialogue becomes too abstract or theoretical about structure vs. spontaneity

example.quote: What of the father who buries his son tomorrow?
